measured_on.changes_made_to_the_phone: audioserver was restarted once to capture the boot-time engine log; no setting, partition or slot was changed

symptom.reported: audio out of the speakers is set to 0 but playing at maximum volume and the slider is not working
symptom.scope: every stream, not only media; media is the one that gets noticed

cause.summary: The audio policy engine ends up with volume groups that hold no volume curves, and a volume group with no curve for the device category reports 0 dB, which is no attenuation.
chain: The audio policy configuration on this device comes from the AIDL HAL, so the engine configuration comes from the HAL too (dumpsys media.audio_policy: 'Config source: AIDL HAL').
The HAL parses its engine XML successfully: AHAL_Config reports 8 strategies and 12 volume groups.

That XML is Xiaomi's, and it declares eight device categories AOSP does not define, 33 curves in all. The xsdc parser turns an unknown enumeration into UNKNOWN and aidl2legacy_DeviceCategory refuses it.
aidl2legacy_AudioHalVolumeGroup_VolumeGroup converts curves with convertContainer, which fails on the first refusal, so engineConfig::convert discards the whole configuration.

EngineBase falls back to gDefaultEngineConfig, whose volumeGroups list is empty, and processParsingResult then creates one group per default strategy from a default-constructed configuration with no curve points.

VolumeCurves::volIndexToDb returns 0.0f when it has no curve for the device category, so every index maps to no attenuation. AudioService mutes a stream by setting index 0, which is why 0 is the loudest position.

evidence.hal_parsed_its_xml: AHAL_Config: getEngineConfig: number of strategies parsed: 8, default strategy: 5, number of volume groups parsed: 12
framework_refused_it: APM::AudioPolicyEngine/Base: loadAudioPolicyEngineConfig: There was an error parsing AIDL data
evidence.curveless_groups: APM::AudioPolicyEngine/Base: processParsingResult: No configuration of AUDIO_STREAM_MUSIC found, using default volume configuration, repeated for all fifteen default groups
evidence.runtime_effect: APM::VolumeCurve: Invalid device category 1 for Volume Curve, emitted by VolumeCurves::volIndexToDb on every volume computation; device category 1 is DEVICE_CATEGORY_SPEAKER
evidence.policy_dump: dumpsys media.audio_policy lists all fifteen volume groups with streams, attributes and index ranges and not one curve point
evidence.engine_in_use_is_the_aosp_default: the live product strategies and volume group names are the AOSP defaults (STRATEGY_MEDIA with AUDIO_STREAM_MUSIC, group names AUDIO_STREAM_*), not the vendor's lowercase names (music, ring, ...)

configuration_files_on_device./vendor/etc/audio_policy_engine_stream_v: 12 groups, only the five AOSP device categories
configuration_files_on_device./odm/etc/audio_policy_engine_stream_volu: 12 groups; 60 curves for the five AOSP categories plus 33 for eight Xiaomi-only ones (A2DP, USB and their CE and SPATIALIZER_CE variants)
configuration_files_on_device./vendor/etc/audio/sku_canoe/audio_policy: the legacy policy file, which XIncludes audio_policy_volumes.xml and default_volume_tables.xml and is what parseLegacyVolumes reads

parts: When the converted HAL engine configuration has no volume groups, fill them from the legacy volume tables before the engine is built, which is what the XML path already does when it finds no engine configuration at all.
fix.left_alone: The AIDL conversion itself. It still fails on the first unrepresentable device category, so the framework keeps the AOSP default product strategies, exactly as on v23.
fix.expected_result: every volume group is built with real curve points and every stream attenuates again

rejected_alternatives.replace_the_engine_xml: The file the HAL reads lives on /vendor and /odm, which this project does not build, and the framework never reads it on the AIDL path anyway.
rejected_alternatives.runtime_workaround: None exists. The curves are built once when audioserver starts the audio policy manager; nothing writable from the shell changes them.

not_established: That the fix restores attenuation on the phone. That is a device result for the delivery set that carries it
Which Xiaomi device category the HAL sends first: the AIDL payload is not readable from the device, so the category list is read out of the ODM XML instead
Whether the AOSP legacy curves sound the same as Xiaomi's per-category tuning; they are not the same numbers

aosp_device_category_mapping.note: every Bluetooth and USB output already lands on a category the file defines, so dropping the Xiaomi-only curves leaves no output without a curve

measured_music_volume_group.framework_index_range_note: AudioService calls initStreamVolume with ro.config.media_vol_steps=150, and Xiaomi authored the curve on that same scale

fallback.mechanism: engineConfig::parseLegacyVolumes() reads the legacy audio policy configuration file and builds one volume group per stream type found in its <volumes> section, named by audio_stream_type_to_string.
fallback.legacy_table_streams_source: frameworks/av/services/audiopolicy/config/audio_policy_volumes.xml at the pinned revision; the device reads the vendor copy of the same file, which was confirmed present and XIncluded by the sku_canoe policy file
fallback.unmatched_group: AUDIO_STREAM_CALL_ASSISTANT, which has no legacy entry and keeps the curveless full-scale behaviour it has today; it carries no audio on this phone
fallback.curves_are_the_aosp_tables_not_xiaomis: the per-category tuning in the ODM file is not used, so absolute levels will not match stock exactly
